transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net mobile technical support, my name is Keith. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Keith. I recently moved into a renovated stone cottage, and my mobile phone keeps dropping from full 4G to 'No Service' as soon as I walk through the front door! I'm missing important work calls and urgent messages!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can troubleshoot your indoor network reception. First let's complete account security. Can you confirm your full name and billing address?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Grace Kelly, 4 Rosehill Cottage, Stroud, GL5 3QJ.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what is the security PIN on your mobile account, Grace?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What model of smartphone are you experiencing this signal drop on?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's an Apple iPhone 14 running iOS 18.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Does the handset regain 4G or 5G coverage when you step outside into the garden?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, as soon as I step outside into the garden, it jumps right back up to three bars of 5G.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms the outdoor mast signal is healthy, but the building materials like foil insulation and stone walls are blocking high-frequency cellular radio waves.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I work remotely from home three days a week, so having zero reception inside my own living room is completely unacceptable! I cannot be expected to stand in the freezing rain to take phone calls!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: S-Net masts cannot penetrate thick Cotswold stone or foil-backed insulation boards.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I need a solution that works inside my house, Keith.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously indoor coverage issues are solved using S-Net Wi-Fi Calling over your home broadband.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What is Wi-Fi Calling and does it cost extra?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wi-Fi Calling routes your standard voice calls and text messages seamlessly over your home Wi-Fi network with zero extra charges.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How do I turn that on on my phone?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Take your phone, open 'Settings', and tap 'Phone'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Settings... Phone... Okay, I'm on the Phone menu.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Scroll down and tap on 'Wi-Fi Calling'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Tapped it. It shows 'Wi-Fi Calling on This iPhone' currently switched off.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Toggle that switch to on. A pop-up prompt will appear explaining emergency 999 location services.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Pop-up appeared. Tapped 'Enable'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: While we are in the settings, let's also verify your Emergency 999 Address is registered correctly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Why is the emergency address needed for Wi-Fi Calling?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Because Wi-Fi Calling does not broadcast cellular cell-site triangulation to emergency operators, so registering your home postcode ensures emergency services know your exact address.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That makes total sense. Where do I update that?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Under the same Wi-Fi Calling menu, tap 'Update Emergency Address'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Tapped it. It shows a web form.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Enter 4 Rosehill Cottage, GL5 3QJ and tap Save.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Typed and tapped Save. It says 'Emergency Address Successfully Registered'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bear with me for thirty seconds while the network register activates the VoWiFi provisioning flag.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting, Grace. The Wi-Fi Calling entitlement has been provisioned on our HLR.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's still flashing No Service when I step into the corridor! This is so frustrating, I really need reliable calls for work!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me check the device configuration again. What model of smartphone are you setting up here?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: As I told you at the start, it's an iPhone 14.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Right, on the iPhone 14, swipe down from the top right corner of the screen to open the Control Center.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Swiped down. At the top left it says 'S-Net Wi-Fi' next to the Wi-Fi symbol!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms your phone is now operating voice and SMS directly over your home Wi-Fi router.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me test making a call while standing in my living room.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Go ahead, dial our automated time and service line on 123.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Dialing now... It's ringing through... Clear automated voice reading the time! The call didn't drop at all!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now let's test receiving a call. I will disconnect our landline desk test and ring your mobile number.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, waiting for the call.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My mobile is ringing! Answered... Keith, can you hear me through Wi-Fi Calling?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes Grace, the call quality is crystal clear high-definition audio.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: This completely solves my indoor dead spot. I don't have to freeze in the garden anymore!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm your contact billing email on file, it's grace dot kelly at cotswold dot co dot uk, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's my email.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm for the record, the installation address is 4 Rosehill Cottage, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, 4 Rosehill Cottage.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will leave notes on your mobile profile so Wi-Fi Calling remains permanently provisioned.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Keith, that is very helpful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else regarding your mobile service that I can assist you with today, Grace?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No Keith, that was the only problem and it's completely sorted. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Grace, and enjoy your new home.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Keith, goodbye.
